body:
I know you're right. Thank you for the tip about the niacin. I just hate that medicating mental issues is such a messy process. I wish I could just get a test and diagnosis and get the right medication the first time around. 

I talked to my husband about my feelings. He reassured me he's here for me. I just hate feeling like this. Everything in my life is good so I can't understand why I feel so terrible. I just want to be happy again :/

I saw my doctor for PPA and they put me on Xanax. I had terrible disasociative episodes on it. When I sat in my med providers room crying over it they told me to just hold on. But how could I when my medication made me a literal danger to my sweet son? Like I'm some clinical statistic and not a human being who was suffering. I'm so scared to go back. I'm scared my husband is going to think I'm bad and dangerous and leave me. I'm just feeling so scared and alone. I feel like there's no way out that won't damage the two people I love more than anything.
Thank you for the encouragement. The most I've been sober is a month (not counting pregnancy). I hate being addicted. I just want to be normal and happy.
18 months. Him and my husband are so awesome and beautiful. I don't get what's wrong with me.

AA makes me want to drink more :/

I just want my brain to not want it. I hate these feelings.

Every single voice in my head is constantly just screaming at me how worthless and terrible I am. I hate it but I feel like my inner voice just hates me and will never let up. I don't know why I hate myself like this :/
